function showGrid$GridVoucherDetail$(g) {

    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {

      for (var j = 0; j < b.length; j++) {

        if (l != -1) g._setColumnVisible(l, !v);
      }
      if (a[i].Value) h += (h == '' ? '' : ',') + a[i].Fields;

function toolbar$]]>&GridExtraToolbarController;<![CDATA[$UpdateData(id) {
  var g = $find(id), row = g._activeRow, column = g._activeColumn, item = g._activeCell, field = item.field, name = field.Name, reference = g._getItem(row, g._getColumnOrder(field.ItemReference));
  var a = ]]>&GridExtraUpdateFields;<![CDATA[, r = '', script = '', formula = ]]>&GridExtraExpression;<![CDATA[;

  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    if ($func.trim(a[i][0]) == name) {
      var e = a[i];
      if (e.length > 1) r = a[i][1];
      if (e.length > 2) script = 'var id = "' + id + '";' + a[i][2];
      break;
    }
  }
  var expression = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < formula.length; i++) {
    if ($func.trim(formula[i][0]) == name) {
      expression = formula[i][1];
      break;
    }
  }

  var fields = r ? r.split(',') : [];
  for (var i = 1; i <= g._rowCount; i++) {
    var o = g._getItem(i, column);
    o.row = i;
    g._activeRow = i;
    if (g._getItemValue(i, column)) continue;

    var result = true;
    if (expression != '') result = g.calcExpression(i - 1, expression, true);
    if (result) {
      if ((field.HandleKey && o.classList.contains('When')) || !field.HandleKey || field.OnDemand) g.setItemGridBehavior(o, [[name, item.value, reference.value, true]]);
      for (var j = 0; j < fields.length; j++) {
        var index = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(fields[j]));
        if ((field.HandleKey && g._getItem(i, index).classList.contains('When')) || !field.HandleKey || field.OnDemand) g._setItemValue(i, index, g._getItemValue(row, index));
      }
      if (script) eval(script);
    }
  }
  g._activeRow = row;
  item.focus();
}
function toolbar$]]>&GridExtraToolbarController;<![CDATA[$DeleteData(id) {
  var g = $find(id), o = g._activeCell;
  if (o) {
    $func.detachControlBehavior(o);
    g._lastCell = o, g._activeCell = null, g._activeRow = -1; 
  }
  for (var i = g._rowCount; i > 0; i--) {
    g._removeRowNumber(i);
  }
  g.raiseGridEvent('AfterRemoveRow');
}

function toolbar$]]>&GridExtraToolbarController;<![CDATA[$GetActiveHeader(g) {
  var f = g.get_element().parentForm;
  var header = '', tabs = f._tabContainer._tabs, v = f._language == 'v';
  for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
    if (tabs.[i]._active) {
      header = tabs.[i]._header.innerHTML;
      if (v) header = header.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + header.slice(1);
      break;
    }
  }
  return header;
}

Name: BI.PickPrice.MultiGrid.Finding
Content:
declare @c char(1), @d char(1), @parentController varchar(64)
select @c = char(253), @d = char(252)

select top 0 cast(0 as numeric(28, 6)) he_so, cast(0 as numeric(28, 6)) as sl_qd, cast(0 as int) as round_gia into #dmqddvt
select * into #t from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@@queryString, @c)

select @parentController = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = (select max(id) from #t)


declare @ngay_ct1 smalldatetime, @ngay_ct2 smalldatetime, @ma_dvcs varchar(32), @ma_bp0 varchar(32), @priceRound int, @ma_nt varchar(16)
declare @ma_kh varchar(32), @ma_vt varchar(32), @ngay_hl_tu char(8), @ngay_hl_den char(8), @dvt char(10), @he_so numeric(28, 6), @so_luong numeric(28, 6)

select @priceRound = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_round_gia'

select @ma_dvcs = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 1
select @ma_bp0 = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 2
select @ma_kh = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 3
select @ma_vt = replace(data, @d, '''') from #t where id = 4
select @ngay_hl_tu = data from #t where id = 5
select @ngay_hl_den = data from #t where id = 6
select @dvt = data from #t where id = 7
select @so_luong = cast(data as numeric(28, 6)) from #t where id = 8

if @ma_dvcs = '' set @ma_dvcs = @@unit
select @he_so = he_so from dmqddvt where ma_vt = @ma_vt and dvt = @dvt
if @he_so is null set @he_so = 1
insert into #dmqddvt select @he_so, @so_luong * @he_so, @priceRound

declare @queryWhereClause nvarchar(4000), @queryFormClause nvarchar(4000)

set @queryFormClause = 'bigia02 m with(nolock) join bigia01 b with(nolock) on m.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and m.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 left join dmkh c on m.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join dmct d on m.ma_ct = d.ma_ct left join #dmqddvt e on 1=1'
set @queryWhereClause = 'b.status = ''1'' and m.ma_vt = ''' + replace(rtrim(@ma_vt), '''', '''''') + ''' and (m.ngay_hl_tu is null or m.ngay_hl_tu <= ''' + @ngay_hl_den + ''') and (m.ngay_hl_den is null or m.ngay_hl_den >= ''' + @ngay_hl_tu + ''')'

if @ma_kh <> '' set @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + ' and m.ma_kh = ''' + replace(rtrim(@ma_kh), '''', '''''') + ''''
if @so_luong > 0 set @queryWhereClause = @queryWhereClause + ' and (b.stt_rec1 = '''' or (b.stt_rec1 <> '''' and b.so_luong = (select max(so_luong) from bigia01 x where x.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and x.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 and x.so_luong <= ' + ltrim(@so_luong * @he_so) + ')))'



declare @q nvarchar(4000), @i int, @m int, @ct_gia_dk nvarchar(4000), @he_so1 numeric(28, 6)
select top 0 identity(int, 1, 1) as id, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ct_gia_dk as x_ct_gia_dk, he_so1 as x_he_so1 into #list from bigia01
set @q = 'insert into #list select b.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, b.stt_rec1, b.ct_gia_dk, he_so1 from ' + @queryFormClause + ' where ' + @queryWhereClause + ' and ct_gia_dk <> '''''
exec sp_executesql @q

select @m = max(id), @i = 1 from #list
if @m > 0 begin
  select top 0 b.line_nbr AS id, a.ma_loai, a.ma_loai as ma_so, b.gia_nt as gia_tri, b.ct_gia_dk as cong_thuc, b.ct_gia_dk as ghi_chu, a.kieu_tinh, a.kieu_cap_nhat
    into #cts from bidmldkg a, bigia01 b
  while @i <= @m begin
    truncate table #cts
    select @ct_gia_dk = x_ct_gia_dk, @he_so1 = x_he_so1 from #list where id = @i
    exec dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_gia_dk, '#cts', 'id, ma_loai, ma_so, gia_tri, cong_thuc, ghi_chu'
    update #cts set kieu_tinh = b.kieu_tinh, kieu_cap_nhat = b.kieu_cap_nhat from #cts a join bidmldkg b on a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai
    update #cts set gia_tri = gia_tri/@he_so1 * @he_so where kieu_tinh = '2' and kieu_cap_nhat IN ('1', '2', '3')

    set @ct_gia_dk = ''
    select @ct_gia_dk = @ct_gia_dk + case when @ct_gia_dk <> '' then ',' else '' end +
          + '["' + replace(rtrim(ma_loai), '"', '\"') + '","'
          + replace(rtrim(ma_so), '"', '\"') + '",'
          + ltrim(cast(isnull(gia_tri, 0) as float)) + ',"'
          + replace(cong_thuc, '"', '\"') + '","'
          + replace(ghi_chu, '"', '\"') + '"]'
        from #cts
    update #list set x_ct_gia_dk = '[' + @ct_gia_dk + ']' where id = @i
    set @i = @i + 1
  end
end
set @queryFormClause = @queryFormClause + ' left join #list l on l.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and l.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 and l.stt_rec1 = b.stt_rec1'



declare @partitionKey nvarchar(4000), @l int, @firstItem varchar(128), @lastItem varchar(128)

select @firstItem = @@firstItem, @lastItem = @@lastItem, @partitionKey = 'convert(char(8), m.ngay_hl_tu, 112) + m.so_ct + m.stt_rec + m.stt_rec0 + replace(str(b.line_nbr, 5), '' '', ''0'')'
select @l = 24 + character_maximum_length from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'wrkcolumns' and column_name = 'so_ct'

if @firstItem <> '' set @firstItem = left(@firstItem, @l) + replace(str(right(@firstItem, len(@firstItem) - @l), 5), ' ', '0')
if @lastItem <> '' set @lastItem = left(@LastItem, @l) + replace(str(right(@lastItem, len(@lastItem) - @l), 5), ' ', '0')

exec FastBusiness$Partition$ExecutePage @@refresh, @@pageIndex, @@pageCount, @@lastPage, @@lastCount, @FirstItem, @LastItem, @@textExternal, @queryFormClause, @queryWhereClause, @@textOrderBy, @partitionKey, 'm.ngay_ct', @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, null, @@admin, @@userID

Content: declare @$checkPurOrg nvarchar(512) select @$checkPurOrg = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Thông tin nhà cung cấp %s1 và đơn vị mua %s2 không hợp lệ.' else 'Vendor information %s1 and Purchasing Organization %s2 are invalid' end if exists(select 1 from bidmnccbp0 where ma_kh = @ma_kh) begin if not exists (select 1 from bidmnccbp0 where ma_kh = @ma_kh and ma_bp0 = @ma_bp0) begin select 'ma_kh' as field, replace(replace(@$checkPurOrg, '%s1', @ma_kh), '%s2', @ma_bp0) as message return end end

Name: GNEditVoucherWhenBeforeUpdate
Content:
declare @$chk bit
select @$chk = 0


declare @$oStatus char(1)
exec sp_executesql N'select @$oStatus = status from @@prime$partition$previous where stt_rec = @stt_rec', N'@stt_rec varchar(32), @$oStatus char(1) output', @stt_rec, @$oStatus output

if @$oStatus in ('9', '2') and @status <> '2' begin
  select '' as field, '$NotAuthorized' as message
  return
end
if @$oStatus in ('9', '2') select @$chk = 1


declare @$eStatus char(1)
exec sp_executesql N'select @$eStatus = tinh_trang from knnh00$$partition$previous where stt_rec = @stt_rec', N'@stt_rec varchar(32), @$eStatus char(1) output', @stt_rec, @$eStatus output
if charindex(@$eStatus, '123') > 0 select @$chk = 1


if @$chk = 1 begin
  
  declare @apv$ChangeField nvarchar(64), @apv$ChangeFieldMsg nvarchar(4000), @apv$Partition varchar(6)
  select @apv$Partition = case when '$partition$previous' <> '' then '$partition$previous' else convert(varchar(6), @ngay_ct, 112) end
  exec FastBusiness$Voucher$General$CheckFieldChange @stt_rec, @@id, @apv$Partition, '', @@language, @@userID, @@admin, '11', @apv$ChangeField out, @apv$ChangeFieldMsg out
  if @apv$ChangeFieldMsg <> '' begin
    select @apv$ChangeField as field, @apv$ChangeFieldMsg as message
    return
  end
end
